title: test_compatible_with_tdma_implementation asserts non-zero but not equality
description:
## Location

python/tests/link/test_channel.py:169-184

## Bug

TestSynchronizedHopChannelCompatibility.test_compatible_with_tdma_implementation computes ch_channel and ch_tdma for matching inputs but only asserts that both are >= 1. The test title and docstring claim to verify channel.py produces compatible results with tdma.py, but the test never asserts ch_channel == ch_tdma.

## Impact

If someone accidentally breaks compatibility between the two implementations (e.g., by changing the hash input order or using a different modulus), this test would NOT catch the regression. The test provides false confidence in implementation parity.

## Fix

Add equality assertion: assert ch_channel == ch_tdma, f"sfn={sfn}, seed={seed}: {ch_channel} != {ch_tdma}"
